motion.name: standard
motion.purpose: Quiet hover, focus, and active-index changes.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: remove transform movement while preserving color and state feedback
motion.purpose: Respect reduced-motion preferences without hiding state feedback.

shadows.name: inset
shadows.purpose: Quiet paper depth inside study surfaces and controls.

shadows.name: raised
shadows.purpose: Small lift for the forward action and selected utility surfaces.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Menus, dialogs, drawers, and temporary layers.

display.purpose: Route headings and primary page titles.

title.purpose: Section headings and prominent session titles.

compact-control.purpose: Dense 32px toolbars, menus, and list controls.

metric.purpose: Duration, TSS, RPE, dates, and counts with tabular numerals.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single indigo forward action in the current task.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 40px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 8px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--brand); color: var(--signal-ink); box-shadow: var(--shadow-raised); font: 600 13px/1 var(--font-schibsted), system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .01em; transition: background-color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--signal-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A reversible paper-toned action with a fine rule.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 40px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 3px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); box-shadow: var(--shadow-inset); font: 600 13px/1 var(--font-schibsted), system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .01em; transition: background-color 180ms ease-out, border-color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--field-focus); background: var(--field-surface); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A labeled paper field with quiet inset depth and an indigo focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: var(--text-secondary); font: 500 13px/1.35 var(--font-schibsted), system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field { min-height: 40px; width: 100%; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--field-border); border-radius: 3px; background: var(--field-surface); color: var(--text); box-shadow: var(--shadow-inset); font: 400 13px/1.4 var(--font-schibsted), system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-field:hover { border-color: var(--field-focus); } .ds-field:focus-visible { border-color: var(--field-focus); outline: 2px solid var(--field-focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: A quiet studio-index destination with an indigo active rail.
components.html: PlannerWorkouts
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; gap: 4px; padding: 8px; background: var(--nav-surface); } .ds-nav-item { min-height: 40px; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 10px 16px; border-left: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: 3px; color: var(--nav-muted); font: 600 13px/1 var(--font-schibsted), system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 180ms ease-out, color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--field-surface); color: var(--nav-text); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-item-active { border-left-color: var(--brand); background: var(--nav-active); color: var(--nav-text); }

components.name: Study Surface
components.description: A warm bordered work surface with restrained inset paper depth.
components.html:
Training week

Plan the work, then follow it through completion.
components.css: .ds-surface { padding: 20px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 3px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); box-shadow: var(--shadow-inset); font-family: var(--font-schibsted), system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-surface h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -.02em; } .ds-surface p { margin: 8px 0 0; color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.55; }

components.name: Session Row
components.description: A navigable study tile combining workout context, stable metrics, and ink-flow feedback.
components.html: Aerobic enduranceToday · 08:00 · Cycling60 min  48 TSS
components.css: .ds-session-row { position: relative; display: grid; gap: 8px; overflow: hidden; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 3px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); box-shadow: var(--shadow-inset); font-family: var(--font-schibsted), system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 180ms ease-out, border-color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-session-row::before { position: absolute; inset: 11px auto 11px 0; width: 2px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--brand); content: ""; transform: scaleY(.2); transition: transform 180ms ease-out; } .ds-session-row:hover { border-color: var(--field-focus); background: var(--field-surface); } .ds-session-row:hover::before, .ds-session-row:focus-visible::before { transform: scaleY(1); } .ds-session-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-session-title { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-session-meta, .ds-session-metrics { color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 14px; } .ds-session-metrics { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: A text-visible state for planned, adjusted, or missed work.
components.css: .ds-status-chip { min-height: 28px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--status-adjusted-border); border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--status-adjusted-tint); color: var(--status-adjusted); box-shadow: var(--shadow-inset); font: 600 12.5px/1 var(--font-schibsted), system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Intensity Timeline
components.description: Duration-proportional workout structure whose height and color both communicate intensity.
components.css: .ds-timeline { width: 288px; height: 32px; display: flex; align-items: end; gap: 2px; overflow: hidden; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); background: transparent; } .ds-timeline i { display: block; transition: height 150ms ease-out; } .ds-zone-1 { height: 20%; flex: 2; background: var(--color-zone-1); } .ds-zone-2 { height: 40%; flex: 1; background: var(--color-zone-2); } .ds-zone-3 { height: 60%; flex: 3; background: var(--color-zone-3); }

narrative.overview: Tempo is an operational training surface organized around the Monday-to-Sunday week and rendered as a quiet ink studio. The week connects personal planning, session execution, completion, and history. The first MVP prioritizes people managing their own training; onboarding, empty states, and primary actions should make sense without a coach connection. Coach collaboration is secondary. The interface should feel crafted and alive through line, texture, and considered transitions while staying quick to use repeatedly rather than performing as a motivational game board. The product world is warm paper, indigo ink, fine rules, editorial spacing, and organic flow linework. The sidebar is a studio index; the main field is a page for the current work; sessions become study tiles and connected marks. The authenticated product is the visual authority. The /design/* routes are alternate visual previews and sample content; they are not production tokens or layouts.
keyCharacteristics: Monday-first hierarchy with the current week and current day easy to locate.
One clear next action before secondary metrics or history.
Shared session, status, metric, and block-structure language across routes.
Warm paper surfaces with semantic borders, fine linework, and restrained depth.
Text-visible states and persistent keyboard focus.

rules.name: The Ink Roles Rule
rules.body: Indigo owns forward action and active context. Blue-gray linework owns focus and flow. Status colors explain what happened; they do not compete with the next action.

rules.name: The Measurement Rule
rules.body: Duration, TSS, RPE, dates, and counts are data. Keep their numerals stable and aligned with MetricText instead of styling each route's metrics as a new visual object.

rules.name: The Paper Depth Rule
rules.body: A surface earns outer elevation only when it is raised by state or interaction, such as a menu, drawer, or dialog. Inset depth belongs to the paper material and should remain quiet.

dos: Do start from DESIGN.md, then inspect app/globals.css and the shared component owner before creating new visual tokens or primitives.
Do keep the current week, current day, session state, and next action in one context when the task requires them together.
Do reuse PageShell, TopBar, shared button and field classes, Surface, SessionRow, StatusBadge, MetricText, and SessionBlockBar.
Do pair every color state with text, structure, or an accessible label.
Do preserve keyboard focus, reduced-motion behavior, explicit labels, readable contrast, and 40px standard action targets. Reserve 32px compact controls for dense contexts with surrounding room.
Do use app/globals.css semantic variables when a token exists instead of introducing an inline color or shadow.
donts: Don't copy the palette, rounded geometry, or dashboard composition from /design/tempo-split or /design/tempo-field; those routes are previews only.
Don't invent a route-local card grammar when a shared session or surface primitive already fits.
Don't make every bordered region a floating card, or every secondary action as prominent as the primary action.
Don't use color alone for planned, completed, adjusted, missed, loading, error, permission, or success states.
Don't add gradients, decorative shadows, oversized hero metrics, or extra accent roles to ordinary authenticated product screens.
Don't use decorative eyebrow labels, section numbers, emoji, or Unicode glyphs as substitutes for hierarchy and the established icon system.
Don't add a new token before checking whether the semantic token in app/globals.css already expresses the state.
